facts.fact: The 2024 finance law appropriated XAF 1,203,574,000 (FCFA, stated domestic revenue) to programme 026 Modernisation du cadastre, chapitre 37 (Ministry of Domains, Cadastre and Land Affairs), whose stated objective is a national digital cadastre; the same amount was proposed on 2023-11-30.
